nested_overrides.reason: Source processing sequence, not a cross-export record identity.
Analytics pipeline metadata; kept without dedicated semantic columns.
Retain publishing/access permission objects, but do not expose them as copyright licences.
Observed attribution-like values make the field name unreliable; preserve as stratigraphic_json.
Reference occurrence owned by its physical assertion; source shape remains distinct from #value.
Alternative source slot for a physical reference; preserve original pointer and payload even where meanings appear similar.
Observed singleton object belongs to the embedded child target, not the containing parent record.
Open representation names and formats; retain PDF originals and source dimensions, not just medium thumbnails.
Flat node list differs from top-level array of hierarchy paths; retain source topology and node type.
Keep complete record_json; report unmapped path/type/occurrence counts and require an explicit decision before claiming projection completeness.
